Professional Profile

Versatile and IB-Certified Educator offering a dual-capability profile: the architectural expertise to launch and lead a rigorous Spanish program, combined with the pedagogical depth to deliver high-impact Secondary English, EAL, and Humanities instruction. Grounded in 4E Cognition, inquiry-based learning, and experiential education, I bridge the gap between academic rigor and holistic student well-being. Proven track record in establishing international examination centers, developing custom EdTech pipelines (H5P/Python), and fostering restorative school communities. I am seeking to leverage my cross-disciplinary expertise to elevate language and humanities departments in forward-thinking international schools.
